quote: the determinantal conjecture of Marcus ([1972]) asks whether the determinant of a sum A + B of two n-by-n normal complex matrices A and B lies in the convex hull of the n! points Πi (λ(A)i + λ(B)σ(i))
note: The conjecture was independently proposed by Marcus in 1972 (published 1972/73 in Indiana University Mathematics Journal) and later by G. N. de Oliveira in 1982. Marcus's work is cited as the original proposal.
